about_pullquote: I started this to prove plumbers don't have to overcharge or disappear on you.
about_para_1: M J W Plumbing was founded on a simple principle: honest work at fair prices, delivered fast. For over 15 years, we've built our reputation across Wolverhampton by turning up on time, fixing the job properly, and treating every home as if it were our own. We're Gas Safe registered and carry full public liability insurance on every callout.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we diagnose the problem clearly, explain your options without jargon, and stick to our quotes. We don't use pressure tactics or push unnecessary work. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned upgrade, you get the same reliable, skilled service — backed by a satisfaction guarantee.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Customers Say About M J W Plumbing

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe flood our kitchen at half ten at night. Called M J W and they were here in 50 minutes. Turned off the water, dried everything out, and sorted the pipe professionally. Honest bloke, reasonable price. Couldn't fault it.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Replaced our boiler and three radiators. They explained everything clearly, no surprises on the bill. The installer was tidy, polite, and finished ahead of schedule. Heating's running beautifully now. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Called them about a leaking tap that was driving us mad. They got someone to us the same day, fixed it quickly, and only charged for the work — no call-out fee. That's proper customer service. Will use them again.
reviews.author: James T.
